specifications.label: Project stage
specifications.value: Built prototype; control refinement and physical qualification ongoing.

specifications.label: Arm architecture
specifications.value: Five controlled arm axes; six arm servos because the shoulder uses a synchronized pair

specifications.label: Current servo record
specifications.value: DS5160SSG shoulder pair and elbow; MS24 replacements reported at base yaw and both wrist axes

specifications.label: Motion/control
specifications.value: ESP32-S3, PCA9685, Python desktop bridge and browser controller; MATLAB/Python kinematics

specifications.label: Nominal reach reference
specifications.value: Approximately 475 mm; design reference, not an independently measured workspace

specifications.label: Payload objective
specifications.value: 500 g object plus tool mass; target only, no qualified load envelope

specifications.label: Shared tool interface
specifications.value: Original star and four-screw mounting interface retained

specifications.label: Gripper Rev B
specifications.value: 108 named parameters, 84 CAD components; 2-26 mm nominal soft-jaw opening, 12 mm travel per jaw

specifications.label: Gripper packaging
specifications.value: 74 x 73 mm nominal case; PETG-CF case, replaceable TPU sleeves; 25 product shapes and six fit coupons

specifications.label: Screwdriver R2
specifications.value: 136 named parameters, 67 CAD components; 4:1 external reduction, 3 mm guided axial compliance

specifications.label: Screwdriver packaging
specifications.value: 80 x 70 mm nominal case; 12 product prints and 11 fit ladders; 287.7 g estimated installed mass, 340 g planning allowance

specifications.label: Tool attachment
specifications.value: Manual exchange through the common mounting interface; automatic docking is future work

specifications.label: Physical evidence
specifications.value: 30-second silent prototype video shows module assembly and coordinated motion

specifications.label: Historical reference
specifications.value: Earlier six-axis animation and 729 mm zero-pose sketches are design history, not current hardware measurements

specifications.label: Budget record
specifications.value: No verified total V1 build cost; dated power/wiring procurement entries are partial and include owned/deferred items
